spec.title: vscode PROP-009: Conventions defaults - subsystems, forbidden services

status.comment: the type's answer to the conventions question of PROP-016 §2; FORBIDDEN-SERVICES-SEED moved verbatim from modules/codkit/PROP-003 in the split of 2026-09-09. The schema of conventions.json, the layer order, the marker grammar and the shape of the id pattern stay in the engine

p.VSCODE-CONVENTIONS-DEFAULTS: The defaults this type contributes to `conventions.json`: the subsystems admitted in an intervention id are `workbench`, `editor`, `platform`, `extensions`, `build`, `product`, `base`, `server`, `test` - the top-level areas of the distribution's own source tree - and the effective `idPattern` is the engine's shape `^CK-(<subsystems joined by |>)-[0-9]{3}$` over that list. The field names, the shape of the pattern, the intervention types, the categories, the layer order and the marker forms are the engine's (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-003#CONV-SUBSYSTEMS`, `spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-003#CONV-ID-PATTERN`); a product extends the list additively through `conventionsExtensionFile` and may not shrink it.

p.FORBIDDEN-SERVICES-SEED: The base `forbiddenServiceIds` protects the bootstrap services that cannot be safely replaced by a late registration. The list is maintained in the installed policy and, at an upgrade, is checked against the actual bootstrap registrations of both the desktop and the web entry of the current pin.
